tip: Problema is masculine even though it ends in -a: o problema, not a problema. Same for tema, sistema, programa.
As slang for guy, cara is masculine: aquele cara. The everyday word a cara means face.
Use está (estar) for changing conditions like traffic: como está o trânsito asks about right now, not a fixed trait.
Posso is I can or may, from poder. Posso plus an infinitive asks for permission: onde posso estacionar.
Assinar means to sign, but it also means to subscribe: eu assino a revista. Same verb, two senses.
Pessoa is grammatically feminine no matter who it refers to: aquela pessoa, even when the person is a man.
Trouxe is the irregular past of trazer (to bring): quem trouxe o bolo = who brought the cake.
In Brazil, tem commonly means there is or there are: onde tem = where is there. The textbook word há is rare in speech.
A gente means we but takes a singular verb: a gente pode, never a gente podemos.
Feriado is a public holiday, a single day off. Vacation time is férias, which is always plural.
Form comparatives with mais before the adjective: mais rápido = faster. Portuguese has no -er ending like English.
The é que in como é que isso funciona is just filler that sounds natural; it means the same as como isso funciona.
Ir plus an infinitive is the everyday future: vão casar = are going to get married. No separate future tense needed.
Brazil takes an article: no Brasil is em plus o Brasil. Many countries do (o Brasil, os EUA), but Portugal takes none.
After a measure, use plain de with no article: um litro de leite, uma xícara de café.
Brazilians put the object pronoun before the verb: me incomoda = bothers me, not the European incomoda-me.
Descriptive adjectives normally follow the noun: computador novo = new computer, not novo computador.
Andar means floor or storey here: o andar de cima = the floor above. The same word andar also means to walk.
Marcar means to book or schedule: marcar a consulta = to make an appointment. Literally it means to mark.
Pasta means folder or briefcase, not the food: os documentos na pasta = the documents in the folder.
